column1: # *** THE TAYLOR FAMILY GROUP, photographed in a studio. ***
# Supplied by David on 8 October 2026 with the identification: "Mary septima and her father mother
# and siblings. she is the girl on her fathers lap on the lower right."
# EVERYTHING IN THE `who` COLUMN THAT IS NOT DAVID'S IDENTIFICATION IS A DESCRIPTION OF THE PRINT,
# not a naming of a person. This archive does not turn a face into a name.

column2: *** Mary Septima, her father, her mother and her siblings *** - David, 8 October 2026
column3: *** THIS IS THE ONLY NAMED PHOTOGRAPH OF MARY SEPTIMA TAYLOR THIS ARCHIVE HOLDS. *** She is identified as the small girl at the *** lower right ***, against the knee of the seated man with full side-whiskers, who is identified as her father. *** NOBODY ELSE IN THE GROUP IS NAMED ***, and this archive will not guess which sibling is which from a face.

column2: Twelve people and an infant, with a small dog asleep on a cushion at the front left
column3: Standing and seated in two ranks before a painted studio backdrop. Two young men; the rest women and girls, several of them grown. *** A seated older woman at centre-left in a fringed shawl *** and *** a seated man at right with full side-whiskers *** read as the parents; a young woman seated at centre holds the infant.

column2: At least eight daughters and two sons are visible, plus an infant
column3: *** THIS IS WHAT A FAMILY CALLED SEPTIMA LOOKS LIKE. *** Her name means *** seventh ***, and the archive has carried it as a curiosity since the beginning. A group this size is the ordinary explanation, and it is the first time the name has had a picture behind it. *** IT IS NOT A COUNT OF THE CHILDREN *** - a studio group is who turned up, not who was born.

*** INFERRED, AND ONLY INFERRED. *** Mary Septima was born *** 17 September 1884 ***. The child identified as her looks about five or six, which would put the sitting around *** 1889-1891 ***. The dress supports that range without narrowing it - high collars, and leg-of-mutton sleeves on the young woman at the right that are only beginning to swell. *** A photographer's imprint, if the mount carries one, would settle it ***, and the supplied image is cropped to the print.

The family is the *** Taylor family of Bideford and Northam, north Devon *** - Mary Septima's birth is registered at *** Bideford ***. A Devon studio is the expectation, and nothing in the image proves it.
